draft.text: You came in for your annual exam and mentioned you have been having chest pain.
You describe the chest pain as a burning feeling in the middle of your chest that happens when you walk and goes away when you rest.
You have not had other symptoms like shortness of breath, nausea, or dizziness.
You are willing to schedule an ECG and stress test to help understand the cause of your chest pain.
